raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma's core innovation is its integrated three-layered architecture (Observe, Intelligence, Execution) that leverages existing foundation models to understand the "Work Graph" and automatically deploy AI agents, specifically addressing the challenges of telemetry, ROI measurement, and drift in AI-first companies.
raw.product_description: Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale. The architecture has three layers. Observe (Layer 1): lightweight desktop sensors capture work patterns including application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Intelligence Layer (Layer 2): a "Brain" that detects employee intent, the business value of tasks, and "drift" where work diverges from the intended flow. Execution Layer (Layer 3): an "Agent Factory" that automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for validated high-ROI opportunities with built-in approval gates. The system uses existing foundation models rather than building its own LLMs, focusing instead on the "Work Graph" to reveal where resources are burned and where AI can intercept work mid-flow to provide assistance. Vision: a single system that observes how work happens, decides what AI should do next, and auto-builds agents continuously to ensure a "Continuous AI lift."
raw.thesis: Narma proposes an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" for AI-first companies to address the significant challenges they face in scaling AI automation. The core innovation lies in its three-layered architecture: an "Observe" layer with lightweight desktop sensors to capture work patterns, an "Intelligence Layer" that detects intent, business value, and "drift," and an "Execution Layer" or "Agent Factory" for automated generation and deployment of AI agents. Narma does not aim to build new LLMs but rather leverages existing foundation models, focusing on understanding the "Work Graph" within an organization. This approach aims to pinpoint where resources are inefficiently utilized and where AI can intervene to provide assistance. The venture targets AI-first companies that struggle with a lack of telemetry, unreliable ROI measurements, and constant system/human resource drift, providing a comprehensive solution to "see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale." This positions Narma as a critical enabler for businesses striving for "Continuous AI lift" by observing work, deciding AI actions, and continuously building agents. The founder's goal appears to be building a growth startup, given the emphasis on "at scale" deployment and "continuous AI lift." At this stage, the venture is at the "idea" stage, with a detailed conceptual architecture but no mention of development or user engagement.
